# EmergentTaskDecomposition

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process by which a global task is automatically split into subtasks through local stigmergic interactions among agents, without explicit planning. Supports scalable and adaptive workload distribution in TCC/iNEST, where centralized control is impractical due to high interconnect complexity.
